Done. Here's what I added and why:

**New permission rules:**

| Action | Roles | Rationale |
|--------|-------|-----------|
| `suspend` | `agent`, `admin` | Agents own in-flight work and need authority to pause it; admins always can. Named explicitly rather than folding into `manage` because suspend has workload-metric consequences (suspended tickets leave active count). |
| `resume` | `agent`, `admin` | Mirrors suspend — same principals who can pause can also restart. Keeps suspend/resume symmetrical so neither requires escalation. |

**Preserved compatibility:**
- Existing `manage` and `archive` rules are untouched.
- `archive` remains admin-only; `suspended` is non-terminal so it gets no `archive`-style restriction.
- No assumptions about which transitions lead to `suspended` — the workflow agent owns that; these rules only constrain who may perform the actions once those transitions exist.
